scope: Preliminary selection of4m pipe sections and homogeneous end fittings for one explicitly confirmed straight continuous PP-R20 cold-water segment. This is not a project cut schedule or a full water-distribution system.

geometry.straight: Один прямой участок — подбор по отрезкам 4 м
geometry.project: Раскладка и количества по проектной ведомости

sources.exactLocator: Selected VALTEC VTp.700.0020.20 pipe, 20x3.4mm, supplied as4m sections; product characteristics remain bound to the previously verified passport

derivedMethod.rule: One continuous segment assembled fromN=ceil(route_length_m/pipe_section_length_m) net sections has max(0,N-1) interior straight joins. Reserve and rounded supplier over-orders do not create installed joins.
derivedMethod.condition: User explicitly selects the single straight4m-section planning layout; no intermediate branches, bends, valves, equipment or penetrations are inferred.
derivedMethod.caps: Selected two caps imply2 caps and0 threaded transitions.
derivedMethod.threaded: Selected two homogeneous threaded endpoints imply2 transitions and0 caps. Their actual interface model remains a separate conditional project fact.
derivedMethod.elbowsAndTees: 0 only for the explicitly selected straight layout.

limitations: Preliminary counts do not prove exact finished length: socket insertion, fitting body dimensions and cut allocation require the actual cut schedule.
Complex routes and existing explicit project counts remain in project mode; no physical topology is inferred from length.
Different endpoint models require a component schedule; the homogeneous selector cannot prove a mixed system.
Support spacing, loads, fixed/sliding placement, compensation, valves, insulation and penetrations remain outside this finite route-layout profile.
independentRequirements: Net sections independently determine interior joins; supplier reserve never increases installed joins
Two declared endings; either2 caps or2 homogeneous threaded transitions
No turns or branches in the selected straight-layout scope
Inherited explicit conflicting quantities must be rejected without altering saved data
